units.source_text: 事情发生在我上东舞鹤中学，寄居在叔父家中，第一学期放暑假，我初次回故乡省亲的时候。

en.t: It happened when I was attending Higashi-Maizuru Middle School, boarding at my uncle's house, and returning home for the first time during the summer vacation after the first term.

units.source_text: 那时母亲的一个名叫仓井的亲戚在大饭的事业失败后回到了成生村，他是人赘女婿，他的妻子不让他踏入家门。

en.t: At that time, a relative of my mother's named Kurai had returned to Nariu Village after his business in Oi failed; he was a son-in-law who had married into his wife's family, and his wife would not let him set foot inside the house.

units.source_text: 妻子未消气之前，他无奈只好寄住在我父亲的寺庙里。

en.t: Until his wife's anger subsided, he had no choice but to stay at my father's temple.
